2609.04523.title: MaxKernel: Agentic Kernel Generation for TPUs
2609.04523.paper_summary: Designing and authoring high-performance custom kernels for accelerators is a complex task that requires deep hardware-level expertise. Large Language Models (LLM) can be leveraged together with real-time compiler feedback to build agentic systems for kernel generation. In this work, we present MaxKernel, a multi-agent system that implements three distinct paradigms for TPU kernel development: (1) a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) agent for collaborative, step-by-step design; (2) an Autonomous (Auto) agent that executes a fully automated, metric/trace-driven optimization loop; and (3) a Graph-Based Autonomous Search that scales the Auto agent for global exploration of the design space. All three paradigms leverage a shared pool of specialized sub-agents to handle planning, implementation, self-debugging, testing, and hardware profiling. We evaluate MaxKernel on JaxBench, a comprehensive suite of 50 diverse kernel tasks for TPUs, alongside complex, real-world workloads from state-of-the-art open-source models. We demonstrate that MaxKernel consistently generates highly optimized implementations, matching expert hand-tuned baselines and delivering significant performance across the benchmark. Our agent is open-sourced and available https://github.com/AI-Hypercomputer/accelerator-agents/tree/main/MaxKernel.
2609.04523.paper_summary_zh: 設計和撰寫高效能自訂核心以用於加速器是一項複雜的任務，需要深入的硬體層級專業知識。大型語言模型（LLM）可以與即時編譯器反饋結合使用，以構建用於核心生成的代理系統。在這項工作中，我們提出了 MaxKernel，一個多代理系統，實現了三種不同的 TPU 核心開發範式：(1) 一個人機協作（HITL）代理，用於協作的逐步設計；(2) 一個自主（Auto）代理，執行完全自動化的度量/追蹤驅動優化循環；以及 (3) 一個基於圖形的自主搜索，擴展 Auto 代理以進行設計空間的全局探索。這三種範式都利用了一個共享的專門子代理池來處理規劃、實施、自我調試、測試和硬體分析。我們在 JaxBench 上評估了 MaxKernel，這是一套包含 50 個多樣化 TPU 核心任務的綜合套件，以及來自最先進開源模型的複雜實際工作負載。我們展示了 MaxKernel 一貫生成高度優化的實現，與專家手動調整的基準相匹配，並在基準測試中提供顯著的性能。我們的代理是開源的，並可在 https://github.com/AI-Hypercomputer/accelerator-agents/tree/main/MaxKernel 獲得。
